messages:
eva: heads up — I just noticed two invoices created in NetSuite for acct_342 after I replayed the webhook DLQ. looks like idempotency didn’t hold.
raj: which replay run was this?\n eva: nightly backfill replay, batch 2026-03-22_03 — payload id wp_88a3.
courtney: ack. can you paste the webhook payload and the NetSuite responses (or logs)?
ledger-bot: processed webhook wp_88a3 -> created invoice NS-10021 (status: success)
ops-bot: webhook retry 3 for wp_88a3 enqueued by dlq_replay/raj
nate: quick note from infra: we've seen invoice DB locks timing out during heavy backfills which leads handlers to retry without seeing the idempotency row.
raj: if the handler retries while the first create is still inflight to NetSuite, both calls can succeed and we end up with duplicates on NS side.
courtney: sounds like our idempotency write happens after remote create. can you confirm?
eva: logs show this sequence — minimal repro below: 
```
POST /webhook handler start payload_id=wp_88a3
call netsuite.createInvoice(payload) -> request_id=req_zt9
... 120s waiting for netsuite (lock / timeout)
handler retries due to DB lock -> calls netsuite.createInvoice(payload) -> request_id=req_ztA
netsuite returns success for both -> our DB idempotency row written after second success
```
raj: so we only persist idempotency on success. that is the race.
nate: we intentionally deferred writing to avoid stale rows for partial failures, but under concurrency this causes duplicate creates.
courtney: proposal: write an optimistic idempotency lock before calling NetSuite (ttl ~5-10m). if another handler sees the lock, it should poll NetSuite for an existing invoice instead of creating.
eva: ttl 5m might be low for backfills — some calls can take longer.
nate: ok set ttl=10m and extend on long polls. also add a uniqueness guard on NetSuite externalId (we already set externalId to payload.id in newer callers).
raj: the problem is backfill/legacy exporter — it doesn't populate externalId for some usage charges. backfill replay is using that exporter.
courtney: short-term hotfix: update the replay transform to inject externalId = payload_id when missing. quick patch on the backfill runner.
eva: action items: 
- apply backfill replay transform to inject externalId for legacy payloads
- change webhook handler to create pre-call idempotency row (with TTL)
- add a dedupe/compensating job to reconcile invoices created between 03:00-04:30 today
raj: who owns the hotfixs?
courtney: I'll own the backfill transform + dedupe script. ETA ~3h. will open PR and run locally.
nate: I'll implement handler change behind a feature flag and run integration tests against sandbox NetSuite.
eva: please paste PR links and CI results here. we need to monitor tonight's backfill.
courtney: PR: https://github.com/redwood/finance/compare/branch/inject-externalid-backfill-2198765432
nate: handler PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/compare/feature/pre-idempotency-lock-2198765432 (WIP)
raj: also add metrics: idempotency_row_lag and webhook_duplicate_creates count. alert if duplicates > 0 in prod.
eva: thanks team :thumbsup:
ledger-bot: scheduled dedupe job created: dedupe-2198765432 (runs at 2026-03-22T09:30:00Z)
courtney: dedupe script run found 1 duplicate pair: NS-10021 and NS-10022 for acct_342. script linked in PR.
eva: merged hotfix for replay transform. monitoring.
nate: handler change merged to canary, running smoke tests against sandbox NS.
raj: root cause summary: idempotency write-after-remote-create + legacy backfill missing externalId -> duplicate NS invoices on DLQ replay. fixes = pre-write lock, backfill injection, uniqueness guard, dedupe job.
eva: I'll file postmortem and tag finance-ops.
